title: Agentic AI Orchestration Framework for Spatial Intelligence: Supply Chain Deployment
abstract: arXiv:2610.34569v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Industrial spatial decisions are assembled across systems that share neither a reference frame nor an owner, and analysts spend substantial effort reconciling those systems rather than reasoning about space. This paper presents ANASSA, a reference architecture integrating structured reasoning, multi-agent workflow orchestration, authoritative spatial grounding, and feedback-driven execution, and reports its instantiation in an operating supply-chain deployment. The architecture places typed data contracts at agent boundaries, validates spatial claims against a certified authoritative foundation, and enforces two blocking human-in-the-loop approvals inside a six-step cognitive loop. The deployment covers multi-hazard risk assessment on an ocean-and-inland freight lane, including cold-chain excursion detection over container telemetry. translated_title: 面向空间智能的智能体AI编排框架：供应链部署
translated_abstract: 工业空间决策是在既不共享参考框架也不共享所有权归属的多个系统中组装而成的，分析师往往要花费大量精力协调这些系统，而非专注于对空间本身的推理。本文提出了ANASSA，一种集成结构化推理、多智能体工作流编排、权威空间基础锚定以及反馈驱动执行的参考架构，并报告了其在实际运行的供应链部署中的实例化。该架构在智能体边界处设置类型化数据契约，针对经过认证的权威基础数据验证空间声明，并在六步认知循环中强制执行两次阻塞性的人在环审批。该部署涵盖海运与内陆货运通道上的多灾害风险评估，包括基于集装箱遥测的冷链异常偏离检测。在为期三个月、包含三次实施迭代的概念验证（POC）过程中，三个部署成果……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 提出了ANASSA参考架构，通过类型化数据契约、权威空间基础验证、多智能体编排与两道人在环审批，解决工业空间决策中跨系统割裂、缺乏统一参考框架的问题，并已在供应链多灾害风险评估场景中实现实际部署。
en_tdlr: ANASSA, a reference architecture that integrates structured reasoning, multi-agent workflow orchestration, authoritative spatial grounding, and blocking human-in-the-loop approvals to reconcile fragmented spatial decision systems, demonstrated in an operating supply-chain deployment for multi-hazard risk assessment.
